title: A High-Order Surface Finite Element Method Based on Intersections with Background Tetrahedral Meshes
summary: This paper develops a high-order surface finite element method for elliptic equations posed on a smooth closed surface implicitly defined as the zero level set of a function in three dimensions. In contrast to classical surface finite element methods that start from a prescribed triangulation of the surface, the proposed method constructs the discrete surface space from the intersections between the exact surface and an ambient tetrahedral mesh.
